# TrackWealth
> AI investment portfolio tracker with real-time insights, smart alerts, and performance analytics.

## What this site does
TrackWealth lets you add your investment holdings — stocks, ETFs, crypto, funds — and get AI-powered analysis, real-time price updates, and smart alerts when your portfolio needs attention. The AI explains market movements in plain English and suggests portfolio rebalancing opportunities.

## Who it's for
Retail investors, self-directed traders, and anyone tracking their investments. Works for beginners who want guidance and experienced investors who want AI-powered analysis without paying for a financial advisor.

## Key features
- Track stocks, ETFs, crypto, and funds in one place
- Real-time price quotes and portfolio valuation
- AI portfolio analysis and plain-English insights
- Smart alerts for price movements and rebalancing signals
- Historical performance charts and analytics
- Export portfolio reports as PDF

## Pricing
Free tier available — track up to 10 holdings. Pro plan from $6.99/month for unlimited holdings and advanced AI analysis.
